2609.38302v1.title: Scale-Covariant Holography
2609.38302v1.abstract: We explore a vast landscape of scale-covariant string backgrounds that arise from the backreaction of D$p$-branes. In a convenient Weyl frame the metric has an AdS factor and the dilaton has a non-trivial profile. This structure provides a notion of scale covariance that facilitates a holographic analysis and provides a window into the dynamics of the dual strongly coupled non-conformal gauge theory. We present different classes of supergravity solutions of this kind and discuss their dual field theory interpretation. We find several new supersymmetric backgrounds arising from D2-branes by utilizing four-dimensional gauged supergravity, D$p$-branes wrapped on compact manifolds, and infinite families constructed directly in ten dimensions. We construct holographic RG flows between some of the new supersymmetric backgrounds and compute the spectrum of low-lying local operators. Holography determines the form of observables such as the thermal free energy and scalar two-point functions, predictions which could be tested on the lattice.

classification.title_zh: 尺度协变全息
classification.abstract_zh: 我们探索了由 D$p$-膜反作用产生的一大类尺度协变弦背景。在方便的 Weyl 标架中，度规具有 AdS 因子，而膨胀子具有非平凡轮廓。这种结构提供了一种尺度协变性的概念，有助于全息分析，并为了解对偶强耦合非共形规范理论的动力学提供窗口。我们给出此类超引力解的不同类别，并讨论其双场论解释。我们利用四维规范超引力发现若干由 D2-膜产生的新超对称背景，以及 D$p$-膜包裹紧致流形的背景和在十维中直接构造的无穷族。我们构造了部分新超对称背景之间的全息 RG 流，并计算低能局域算符谱。全息确定了热自由能和标量两点函数等可观测量的形式，这些预言可在格点上检验。
classification.one_liner: 研究 Dp-膜反作用产生的尺度协变超引力背景及其非共形规范理论对偶、RG 流和可观测量的全息预言。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文属于全息对偶与非共形规范理论、全息 RG 流和算符谱方向，与 AdS/CFT 基础相关；但不直接涉及用户列出的全息超流超导、p波、multi-trace、QNM、探针膜、冷原子或经典引力等重点支线。

2609.38308v1.title: Bootstrapping Weakly Broken Gauge Theories in (A)dS
2609.38308v1.abstract: We develop a bootstrap approach for weakly broken gauge theories in (anti-)de Sitter space, focusing on cases in which the conservation of the dual boundary current is broken by a double-trace operator. Integrating the corresponding Ward identity, we derive pseudo-charge conservation identities that contain fixed nonlocal contributions as integrals of three-point functions. These identities impose consistency conditions on the space of allowed theories. As an illustrative example, we study Yang-Mills theory in AdS with symmetry-breaking boundary conditions for charged matter and show that the pseudo-charge conservation identities constrain the mixing between the two quantization sectors. We then apply the framework to the Higgs mechanism for gravity in two AdS spaces with a common boundary, coupled so that the corresponding stress tensors are not separately conserved. In this setting, the ordinary charge conservation identities recover the factorization into two independent CFTs, whereas the pseudo-charge conservation identities hold for arbitrary values of the symmetry-breaking parameter. Finally, for conformal gravity in de Sitter space, we constrain the interactions between the graviton and the partially massless spin-2 field, both in the minimal theory and in the presence of additional scalar or vector matter, finding agreement with the predictions of the corresponding bulk theories.

classification.title_zh: (A)dS 中弱破缺规范理论的自举
classification.abstract_zh: 我们发展了（反）de Sitter 空间中弱破缺规范理论的自举方法，重点关注对偶边界流守恒被双迹算符破缺的情形。通过积分相应的 Ward 恒等式，我们导出赝荷守恒恒等式，其中包含由三点函数积分给出的固定非局域贡献。这些恒等式对允许的理论空间施加一致性条件。作为示例，我们研究 AdS 中带破缺对称边界条件的 Yang-Mills 理论（带电物质），并表明赝荷守恒恒等式约束两个量子化扇区之间的混合。随后，我们将该框架应用于两个具有共同边界的 AdS 空间中的引力 Higgs 机制，二者耦合使得对应的应力张量不分别守恒。在此设定中，普通荷守恒恒等式恢复为两个独立 CFT 的因子化，而赝荷守恒恒等式对任意对称性破缺参数值成立。最后，对于 de Sitter 空间中的共形引力，我们约束引力子与部分无质量自旋-2 场之间的相互作用，包括最小理论以及存在额外标量或矢量物质的情形，结果与相应体理论的预言一致。
classification.one_liner: 通过 Ward 恒等式导出的赝荷守恒恒等式，为 (A)dS 中双迹破缺规范理论及 dS 共形引力中的引力子—部分无质量自旋-2 相互作用提供自举约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究双迹算符破缺对偶边界流守恒，并导出赝荷守恒恒等式，属于 multi-trace 形变与全息自举的核心内容，与用户重点标签 multi-trace 高度相关。

2609.38311v1.title: A New Approach to Black Hole Thermodynamics in General EMD-like Theories
2609.38311v1.abstract: We consider general EMD-like theories involving arbitrary numbers of both Maxwell fields and dilatonic scalars. We study charged black holes and derive several algebraic and differential relations among the thermodynamic quantities, scalar charges and the non-extremal parameter. These allow us to obtain two sets of master equations of thermodynamic quantities, depending on the choice of basic variables parameterizing the system. Solutions to either set of the master equations give rise to all the thermodynamic quantities, without constructing black hole solutions. We obtain all the thermodynamic quantities perturbatively in the power series expansions of charges, which we then verify using perturbative black hole solutions up to and including the quartic order in charges.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 一般 EMD 类理论中黑洞热力学的新方法
classification.abstract_zh: 我们考虑包含任意数量麦克斯韦场和伸缩子标量的一般 EMD 类理论。我们研究带电黑洞，并推导热力学量、标量荷与非极端参数之间的若干代数与微分关系。这些关系使我们能够根据参数化系统的基本变量选择，得到两组热力学量的主方程。任一组主方程的解都能给出全部热力学量，而无需构造黑洞解。我们在电荷的幂级数展开中微扰地获得全部热力学量，并利用微扰黑洞解在电荷的四阶及以下进行验证。
classification.one_liner: 在不构造黑洞解的情况下，通过主方程从电荷展开得到一般 EMD 类理论中带电黑洞的全部热力学量。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典黑洞热力学与 EMD 类引力理论，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点方向；但摘要未涉及 AdS/CFT、全息字典或量子引力，因此全息相关性有限。

2609.38313v1.title: Holographic Krylov spread complexity for a confining multi-charge AdS soliton
2609.38313v1.abstract: We study holographic spread complexity for a Type IIB solution dual to a deformation of $\mathcal{N} = 4$ SYM that flows to a confining (2+1)-dimensional supersymmetric theory in the IR. We use the proposal that relates the rate of change of spread complexity of local operators with the proper momentum of an infalling probe particle in the bulk. We analyse two cases: a probe particle falling radially and a probe falling radially while rotating with conserved angular momentum. We elaborate on how to define the proper coordinate in the presence of a conserved Noether charge using the Routhian. The trajectories for the probes were studied numerically, revealing an oscillatory behaviour of the complexity.

classification.title_zh: 约束性多电荷 AdS 孤子的全息 Krylov 扩展复杂度
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了与一个流向红外 (2+1) 维超对称约束理论的 N=4 SYM 形变对偶的 IIB 型解的全息扩展复杂度。我们采用将局域算符扩展复杂度的变化率与体时空中下落探针粒子的固有动量相联系的提议。我们分析两种情况：探针粒子径向下落，以及探针在具有守恒角动量的情况下边旋转边径向下落。我们说明在存在守恒 Noether 荷时如何利用 Routhian 定义固有坐标。对探针轨迹进行了数值研究，揭示出复杂度的振荡行为。
classification.one_liner: 该文用落入多电荷 AdS 孤子背景的探针粒子，研究对偶约束规范理论中局域算符的全息 Krylov 扩展复杂度及其振荡行为。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题属于全息复杂度/量子信息，并与多电荷 AdS 孤子和约束背景相关；但主要不是用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波序参量、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7 探针膜等具体支线，仅与孤子/非均匀背景有交集。

2609.38318v1.title: Energy Transmission Across Holographic Conformal Interfaces in General Dimensions
2609.38318v1.abstract: Energy transport across conformal interfaces is universal in two spacetime dimensions, but its higher-dimensional counterpart has remained largely unexplored. In higher dimensions, scattering can depend on additional kinematic data, such as the angle of incidence, and conformal symmetry is far less restrictive. We use gravitational holography to study this problem. For a broad class of AdS$_d$-sliced domain-wall geometries, we derive a closed-form expression for the energy transmission coefficient in terms of the bulk warp factor. Our formula reproduces known two-dimensional holographic results and extends them to arbitrary dimension. Within this class, we establish different aspects of higher-dimensional universality. In particular, we show that the transmission is independent of the incidence angle and of the profile of the incident perturbation. We also derive bounds on transmission controlled by central-charge-like quantities characterizing the number of degrees of freedom of the theories on the two sides of the interface. This provides the first explicit result for reflection and transmission across conformal interfaces in higher dimensions, where no CFT-based results are currently available.

classification.title_zh: 一般维度下全息共形界面上的能量传输
classification.abstract_zh: 二维时空中跨共形界面的能量输运具有普适性，但其高维对应问题仍基本未被探索。在高维中，散射可能依赖于额外的运动学数据，例如入射角，而共形对称性的限制也弱得多。我们利用引力全息研究这一问题。对于一大类 AdS_d 切片的畴壁几何，我们导出了能量透射系数的闭式表达式，用体时空的翘曲因子表示。我们的公式重现了已知的二维全息结果，并将其推广到任意维度。在这一类几何中，我们确立了高维普适性的不同方面。特别地，我们证明透射不依赖于入射角，也不依赖于入射扰动的剖面。我们还导出了由类中心荷量控制的透射界限，这些量刻画了界面两侧理论自由度的数目。这给出了高维共形界面反射和透射的首个显式结果，而目前尚无基于 CFT 的结果。
classification.one_liner: 利用引力全息导出一般维度共形界面的能量透射系数，并证明其对入射角与扰动剖面不依赖。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文核心为全息畴壁几何中的能量传输，直接匹配用户重点标签“畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀”，并涉及 AdS/CFT 字典与共形界面，与用户的非均匀态/畴壁研究支线高度相关。

2609.38336v1.title: Scaling similarity and generalised conformal symmetry in D2-brane holography
2609.38336v1.abstract: We study D2-brane holography within the purely dilatonic sector of four-dimensional maximal ISO(7)-gauged supergravity, obtained as a consistent truncation of type IIA supergravity on S$^6$. In the dual frame, the four-dimensional Lagrangian resulting from the reduction of the massless IIA theory exhibits scaling similarity, thus reflecting the generalised conformal symmetry of the dual three-dimensional maximally supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory. Using an auxiliary spacetime construction, we show that the holographic CFT$_3$ fixed points and RG-flows known in the massive IIA theory have natural counterparts in the massless IIA theory: QFT$_3$s with generalised conformal symmetry connected by generalised RG-flows, which we construct numerically. We also revisit the Coulomb branch solutions and propose an extension of Gubser's singularity criterion to supergravity theories exhibiting scaling similarity.

classification.title_zh: D2-膜全息中的标度相似性与广义共形对称性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在四维最大 ISO(7) 规范超引力的纯膨胀子扇区中研究 D2-膜全息，该扇区可由 IIA 型超引力在 S^6 上的相容截断得到。在对偶框架中，由无质量 IIA 理论约化得到的四维拉氏量表现出标度相似性，从而反映对偶三维最大超对称 Yang-Mills 理论的广义共形对称性。利用辅助时空构造，我们表明大质量 IIA 理论中已知的全息 CFT3 不动点和 RG 流在无质量 IIA 理论中有自然的对应物：具有广义共形对称性的 QFT3，由广义 RG 流连接，我们数值构造了这些流。我们还重新审视库仑分支解，并提议将 Gubser 奇点判据推广到表现出标度相似性的超引力理论。
classification.one_liner: 在 D2-膜全息中，无质量 IIA 的四维对偶拉氏量呈现标度相似性，对应具有广义共形对称性的 QFT3 及广义 RG 流，并推广 Gubser 奇点判据。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 D2-膜全息、超引力与全息 RG 流，主题落在 AdS/CFT 基础；与用户重点中的经典引力/超引力解及 Gubser 判据有方法层面相关，但不涉及全息超导、p波、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、气泡成核、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7/Floquet 等支线。

2609.38815v1.title: Relative entropy of entanglement and tripartite minimal surface
2609.38815v1.abstract: We propose a holographic dual of the relative entropy of entanglement for a boundary tripartition $A:B:C$. Our proposal is that, at the leading order, \begin{align} E_R(\rho_{AB}) = \frac{1}{4G_N}\Big[\mathrm{Area}(\Gamma_{\min}) - \mathrm{Area}(\gamma_{AB})\Big] \notag \end{align} where $\Gamma_{\min}$ is the minimal bulk tripartition surface and $\gamma_{AB}$ is the minimal surface homologous to $AB$. For a general random tensor network, we prove the corresponding upper bound by constructing a separable state associated with $\Gamma_{\min}$ and evaluating its relative entropy. We also establish the matching lower bound rigorously for networks of one, two, and three Haar random tensors by bounding the maximal tripartite product-state overlap. In appropriate geometries, the minimal tripartition surface can form a nontrivial tri-junction resembling the Mercedes logo. The proof proceeds by sequential optimization over candidate product states, which has a natural geometric interpretation as a local search for the minimal tripartition surface.

classification.title_zh: 纠缠的相对熵与三部分极小曲面
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为边界三分区 A:B:C 的纠缠相对熵提出一个全息对偶。我们的提议是，在领头阶，E_R(ρ_AB) = 1/(4G_N)[Area(Γ_min) - Area(γ_AB)]，其中 Γ_min 是体内部极小三分区曲面，γ_AB 是与 AB 同调的极小曲面。对于一般随机张量网络，我们通过构造与 Γ_min 相关的可分态并计算其相对熵，证明了相应的上界。我们还通过对最大三体乘积态重叠进行界估计，对一、二、三个 Haar 随机张量网络严格建立了匹配的下界。在适当几何中，极小三分区曲面可形成类似梅赛德斯标志的非平庸三叉结。证明通过对候选乘积态的顺序优化进行，这具有自然的几何解释，即对极小三分区曲面的局部搜索。
classification.one_liner: 提出边界三分区 A:B:C 的纠缠相对熵的全息对偶，用体内部极小三分区曲面与 AB 的极小曲面面积差表示，并在随机张量网络中证明上下界。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于 AdS/CFT 全息纠缠与量子信息核心方向，但与用户列出的全息超流超导、p波/多分量序参量、multi-trace、QNM、经典引力等重点标签无直接重合。

2609.39253v1.title: Gravitational multipoles, antipodal matching relations, and the logarithmic soft graviton theorem
2609.39253v1.abstract: We derive the classical logarithmic soft graviton theorem for the scattering of massive particles in four-dimensional asymptotically flat spacetime using a position-space analysis of the Weyl tensor. Starting from the Iyer-Damour multipole solution in harmonic gauge, we obtain an infinite tower of antipodal matching relations across spatial infinity for all five Newman-Penrose Weyl scalars, at linear order in $G$ and for the leading matter-induced logarithms at order $G^2$. We connect the relation relevant to the logarithmic soft theorem to the radiative-gauge formulation of Boschetti-Campiglia and Comp\`ere-Robert. We then compute the required asymptotic fields directly from scattering data, including matter contributions and nonlinear effects responsible for graviton drag. Combining these results with the Newman-Penrose evolution equations yields position-space proofs of the classical leading and logarithmic soft graviton theorems, independently confirming the frequency-space derivation of the latter originally performed by Laddha and Sen.

classification.title_zh: 引力多极矩、对跖匹配关系与对数软引力子定理
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过对 Weyl 张量进行位置空间分析，推导了四维渐近平直时空中大质量粒子散射的经典对数软引力子定理。从谐和规范中的 Iyer-Damour 多极矩解出发，我们在 G 线性阶以及 G^2 阶领头物质诱导对数项上，得到了跨越空间无穷远的、对所有五个 Newman-Penrose Weyl 标量的无穷多对跖匹配关系。我们将与对数软定理相关的关系联系到 Boschetti-Campiglia 以及 Compère-Robert 的辐射规范表述。随后，我们直接从散射数据计算所需的渐近场，包括物质贡献以及导致引力子拖曳的非线性效应。将这些结果与 Newman-Penrose 演化方程结合，给出了经典领头和经典对数软引力子定理的位置空间证明，独立确认了 Laddha 和 Sen 原先在频率空间中对对数定理的推导。
classification.one_liner: 用 Iyer-Damour 多极矩和 Weyl 张量的位置空间分析，证明经典领头与对数软引力子定理，并给出跨空间无穷远的对跖匹配关系。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接属于用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究渐近平直时空、Weyl 张量、多极矩与软引力子定理；未涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶核心方法。

2609.39288v1.title: Near-horizon soft theorems from local Ward identities
2609.39288v1.abstract: We develop a unified formulation of leading soft photon theorems for nondegenerate static spherical horizons. By fixing the photon mode normalization from the horizon symplectic form, we obtain a common angular soft factor whose sign follows from the boundary orientation. We determine the geometric coefficients in the local angular and momentum representations for a chosen radial normalization. The charge balance includes horizon endpoint data and contributions from other boundaries. This formulation brings black hole and cosmological horizons into a common description. Applying the same construction to Yang-Mills fields yields the corresponding tree-level soft gluon theorem. These results identify the common soft structure underlying different horizon geometries.

classification.title_zh: 从局部 Ward 恒等式得到近视界软定理
classification.abstract_zh: 我们发展了非退化静态球对称视界的领头软光子定理的统一表述。通过由视界辛形式固定光子模式归一化，我们得到一个共同的角向软因子，其符号由边界取向决定。对于选定的径向归一化，我们确定了局域角向表示和动量表示中的几何系数。电荷平衡包含视界端点数据以及其他边界的贡献。该表述将黑洞视界和宇宙学视界纳入一个共同描述。将同样构造应用于 Yang-Mills 场，可得到相应的树级软胶子定理。这些结果识别出不同视界几何背后的共同软结构。
classification.one_liner: 利用局域 Ward 恒等式统一给出静态球对称视界上的领头软光子/软胶子定理。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究近视界软定理与视界辛形式，涉及黑洞和宇宙学视界，与经典引力/广义相对论支线相关；但不涉及全息超流、QNM、multi-trace 等用户具体研究支线。

2609.39769v1.title: AI for BMN Strings
2609.39769v1.abstract: With the assistance of AI (Artificial Intelligence) tools, we revisit some mathematically well-formulated problems from our previous studies of BMN (Berenstein-Maldacena-Nastase) strings on type IIB string theory pp-wave background. These mathematical problems have important physical implications, relating to the computations of higher-genus critical superstring amplitudes, possible estimate of the cosmological constant. We make significant progress on some problems, while others remain unresolved.

classification.title_zh: AI 辅助的 BMN 弦研究
classification.abstract_zh: 借助 AI（人工智能）工具，我们重新审视了此前对 IIB 型弦理论 pp-wave 背景上 BMN（Berenstein-Maldacena-Nastase）弦研究中的一些数学表述良好的问题。这些数学问题具有重要物理意义，涉及高亏格临界超弦振幅的计算，以及宇宙学常数的可能估计。我们在某些问题上取得显著进展，而其他问题仍未解决。
classification.one_liner: 借助 AI 工具重新研究 IIB 型 pp-wave 背景上的 BMN 弦数学问题，涉及高亏格超弦振幅与宇宙学常数估计，部分取得进展。
classification.relevance_reason: BMN/pp-wave 是 AdS/CFT 平面波极限下的弦论问题，属于全息基础；但摘要未直接涉及用户重点标签中的具体支线，且方法依赖 AI 工具。

2609.39893v1.title: Light non-vacuum BMS$_3$ blocks at order $1/c_{M}$
2609.39893v1.abstract: We derive a closed expression for the $1/c_{M}$ correction to highest-weight BMS$_3$ blocks with four light external primaries of generic weights and non-vacuum exchange. With $c_L$ and all operator weights held fixed, we prove that the global sector and descendants containing exactly one non-global generator $L_{-n}$ or $M_{-n}$ with $n\geq2$ suffice through this order. This truncation reduces the intrinsic calculation to global blocks and their derivatives, whose contributions we resum for nonzero exchanged boost weight $\xi_{p}$. For pairwise identical external operators, we independently reproduce the correction through the introduction of boundary gravitons in the normalized three-point functions in the shadow representation, while keeping the exchanged two-point function fixed. The analogous prescription also reproduces the known non-vacuum Virasoro correction at order $1/c$. For the same external configuration, a formal ultra-relativistic contraction of Virasoro blocks with one flipped chiral representation provides a further check: it yields the same correction, and we prove that contraction commutes with extraction of the $1/c_{M}$ coefficient at each fixed descendant level. The degenerate exchange with $\xi_{p}=0$ requires a separate quotient construction and is not obtained as a smooth limit of the generic block, which we discuss in the appendix.

classification.title_zh: 轻非真空 BMS$_3$ 块在 $1/c_M$ 阶
classification.abstract_zh: 我们推导了最高权 BMS$_3$ 块在 $1/c_M$ 阶修正的闭式表达式，涉及四个轻外部原初场、一般权重和非真空交换。在固定 $c_L$ 与所有算符权重时，我们证明到该阶只需全局扇区以及恰含一个非全局生成元 $L_{-n}$ 或 $M_{-n}$（$n\geq2$）的后代。该截断将内在计算约化为全局块及其导数；对于非零交换 boost 权重 $\xi_p$，我们对其贡献进行重求和。对于两两相同的外部算符，我们独立地通过在 shadow 表示下归一化三点函数中引入边界引力子来重现该修正，同时保持交换的两点函数固定。类似方案也重现了 $1/c$ 阶已知的非真空 Virasoro 修正。对于相同外部构型，带有翻转手征表示的 Virasoro 块的形式超相对论收缩提供了进一步检验：它给出相同修正，并且我们证明该收缩与在每一固定后代能级提取 $1/c_M$ 系数可交换。$\xi_p=0$ 的退化交换需要单独的商构造，不能作为一般块的光滑极限得到，我们在附录中讨论。
classification.one_liner: 推导了轻非真空 BMS$_3$ 块至 $1/c_M$ 阶的闭式修正，并给出截断、边界引力子与超相对论收缩检验。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于平直时空/BMS-Carroll 的形式化共形块计算，与天球/平直全息相关，但不直接匹配重点标签中的全息超导、相变、QNM、探针膜或经典引力等具体支线。

2609.39930v1.title: Large gaps and BTZ entropy in modular spectra with positive integer degeneracies
2609.39930v1.abstract: We construct modular-invariant torus partition functions with a unique vacuum, discrete energy levels and positive integer degeneracies by recursively repairing the Maloney--Witten--Keller modular completion of the Virasoro vacuum. Exact modular repairs and finite moment matching discretize successive spectral bands while preserving earlier levels and controlling convergence. For $c_L=c_R=c$ and $a=(c-1)/12$, the construction realizes primary dimension gaps $\Delta_1=(1+\kappa)a$ for sufficiently small fixed $\kappa>0$, and $\Delta_1=a+\delta$ for any fixed $\delta\ge0$, at every sufficiently large real $c$. Every nonvacuum primary satisfies $h,\bar h\ge(c-1)/24$. In the fixed-$\delta$ family, spectra can be chosen whose densities of states, smoothed with a fixed nonnegative normalized smooth kernel of compact support, match the correspondingly smoothed prediction of a single perturbative BTZ saddle through every fixed finite order in $1/c$. The count includes all spins and Virasoro descendants. Its logarithm reproduces the Bekenstein--Hawking entropy and its corrections at every fixed positive $E/c$, where $E=\Delta-c/12$. This includes $0<E<c/12$, where thermal AdS dominates the canonical ensemble.

classification.title_zh: 具有正整数简并度的模谱中的大能隙与 BTZ 熵
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过递归修复 Virasoro 真空的 Maloney--Witten--Keller 模完成，构造了具有唯一真空、离散能级和正整数简并度的模不变环面配分函数。精确模修复和有限矩匹配离散化连续的谱带，同时保持先前能级并控制收敛性。对于 c_L=c_R=c 和 a=(c-1)/12，该构造在足够小的固定 κ>0 下实现主维度间隙 Δ1=(1+κ)a，并对任意固定 δ≥0 实现 Δ1=a+δ，且对每个足够大的实 c 成立。每个非真空主算子满足 h,\bar h≥(c-1)/24。在固定 δ 族中，可以选择谱，使得其态密度（用固定非负归一化紧支撑光滑核平滑后）在 1/c 的每个固定有限阶上匹配单个微扰 BTZ 鞍点的相应平滑预测。计数包括所有自旋和 Virasoro 后代。其对数在每个固定正 E/c 上重现 Bekenstein--Hawking 熵及其修正，其中 E=Δ-c/12。这包括 0<E<c/12，其中热 AdS 在正则系综中占主导。
classification.one_liner: 构造模不变 CFT 谱，给出大能隙并逐阶重现 BTZ 的 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵。

2609.39944v1.title: Greybody factors of large Gauss-Bonnet d-dimensional black holes
2609.39944v1.abstract: We compute analytically greybody factors for d-dimensional large spherically symmetric black holes with Gauss-Bonnet corrections in the high frequency limit. Our calculations include both the eikonal limit, where the real part of the frequency of the scattered wave is much larger than the imaginary part, and the highly damped case,where the imaginary part of the frequency is much larger than the real part, addressing the emission of gravitons and test scalar fields, and yielding full transmission and reflection scattering coefficients. We consider tensorial, vectorial and scalar gravitational perturbations, obtaining the same result for the three cases in the highly damped limit, but not in the eikonal limit.

classification.title_zh: 含 Gauss-Bonnet 修正的 d 维大黑洞的灰体因子
classification.abstract_zh: 我们解析计算了在高频极限下，含 Gauss-Bonnet 修正的 d 维大球对称黑洞的灰体因子。我们的计算涵盖 eikonal 极限（散射波频率的实部远大于虚部）与强阻尼情形（频率的虚部远大于实部），处理了引力子和试探标量场的发射，并给出完整的透射与反射散射系数。我们考虑张量、矢量与标量引力扰动，在强阻尼极限下三者得到相同结果，但在 eikonal 极限下并不相同。
classification.one_liner: 在高频极限下解析给出含 Gauss-Bonnet 修正的高维大球对称黑洞灰体因子，并比较不同引力扰动在 eikonal 与强阻尼极限下的透射和反射系数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究经典黑洞时空中的灰体因子与引力扰动，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；摘要未涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

2609.38461v1.title: Explicit Analytical Representations for the Schwarzschild Radial Equation via Hypergeometric and Frobenius Expansions
2609.38461v1.abstract: The massive Klein-Gordon equation on the Schwarzschild exterior reduces to a radial differential equation of confluent-Heun type. We present its exact reduction by rigorously retaining a subleading centrifugal term that preserves the horizon indicial exponents but critically shifts the accessory parameters. Within the Svartholm--Schmidt hypergeometric-expansion framework, we derive the three-term recurrence relation and establish the corrected continued-fraction compatibility condition matching the minimal tail to the lower-end recurrence. Crucially, we demonstrate that the physical compactification coordinate $z=(r-1)/r$ shifts the irregular singular point to $z=1$, inherently transforming the hypergeometric expansion into a five-term recurrence that cannot degenerate to three terms. To circumvent this obstruction, we construct the horizon-normalized physical branch via a direct Frobenius series at $z=0$. This representation exhibits high-order convergence and near-precision-floor residuals against the exact radial ODE, while clarifying why quasinormal-mode spectral selection remains a connection problem at the irregular singular endpoint.

classification.title_zh: Schwarzschild径向方程的显式解析表示：基于超几何与Frobenius展开
classification.abstract_zh: Schwarzschild外部的大质量Klein-Gordon方程约化为一种合流Heun型径向微分方程。我们通过严格保留一个次领头离心项给出其精确约化，该保留项保持视界指标指数不变，但关键地移动了附属参数。在Svartholm--Schmidt超几何展开框架内，我们导出三项递推关系，并建立修正的连分数相容条件，使最小尾部与低端递推匹配。关键的是，我们证明物理紧化坐标 z=(r-1)/r 将不规则奇点移到 z=1，从而本质上把超几何展开变为不能退化为三项的五项递推。为绕过这一障碍，我们通过在 z=0 处的直接Frobenius级数构造视界归一化的物理支。该表示表现出高阶收敛，并相对精确径向ODE具有接近精度下限的残差，同时阐明为何准正规模谱选择仍然是不规则奇点端点处的连接问题。
classification.one_liner: 该文给出Schwarzschild径向方程的解析约化与超几何/Frobenius显式表示，并讨论准正规模谱选择的连接问题。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究Schwarzschild黑洞径向方程与准正规模的解析求解，属于重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论与QNM方向；但不涉及全息对偶。

2609.38605v1.title: Quasi-Einstein metrics from Horava gravity
2609.38605v1.abstract: In this note we present a direct relation between the geometrical definition of a quasi-Einstein metric and Horava gravity: the solutions of the large-distance effective action of Horava gravity that are static and orthogonal are quasi-Einstein metrics. The converse is also true if the function over the quasi-Einstein manifold satisfies a given equation.

classification.title_zh: 从Hořava引力得到的准爱因斯坦度规
classification.abstract_zh: 在本注记中，我们给出准爱因斯坦度规的几何定义与Hořava引力之间的直接关系：Hořava引力大距离有效作用量中静态且正交的解是准爱因斯坦度规。反过来，如果准爱因斯坦流形上的函数满足给定方程，则逆命题也成立。
classification.one_liner: Hořava引力大距离有效作用量的静态正交解与准爱因斯坦度规相对应，并在附加函数方程下可反向构造。

2609.38649v1.title: Quadrupolar logarithmic tidal response of Einstein Euler Heisenberg black holes: the role of the second electromagnetic invariant
2609.38649v1.abstract: We determine the quadrupolar logarithmic tidal response of electrically charged Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg black holes from the coupled static odd-parity gravitational and electromagnetic equations. Although the second electromagnetic invariant vanishes on the electric background, its quadratic interaction contributes to the axial fluctuation equations. At first order in the Euler-Heisenberg coupling $a$, a direct asymptotic recursion gives the canonical running matrix $C_{\rm can}^{\rm EH}=(9aQ^2/10)\left(\begin{smallmatrix}0&-Q\\-Q&M\end{smallmatrix}\right)$, deffined as the coefficients multiplying the canonical source vector in the $r^{-2}\log(r_0/r)$ term. The resulting local coefficients retain the full dependence on the the subextremal ratio $\frac{Q}{M}$ at this perturbative order. The two quartic invariants partially cancel in both nonzero channels, while the action-normalized fields make gravitoelectromagnetic reciprocity explicit. The local extremal limit of the running matrix reproduces the corresponding two-invariant effective-field-theory result after convention conversion. Allowing independent quartic couplings further shows that identical electric background geometries can have different axial running matrices and yields algebraic inverse relations within the specified two-operator model. The calculation determines local logarithmic running within minimally coupled quartic electrodynamics; the finite horizon-matched response requires an additional global matching calculation.

classification.title_zh: Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg 黑洞的四极对数潮汐响应：第二电磁不变量的作用
classification.abstract_zh: 我们从耦合的静态奇宇称引力与电磁方程出发，确定带电 Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg 黑洞的四极对数潮汐响应。尽管第二电磁不变量在电背景上为零，其二次相互作用仍对轴向涨落方程有贡献。在 Euler-Heisenberg 耦合 a 的一阶，直接的渐近递推给出正则跑动矩阵 C_can^EH=(9aQ^2/10)([[0,-Q],[-Q,M]])，其定义为 r^{-2}\log(r_0/r) 项中乘在正则源矢量上的系数。所得局域系数在此微扰阶保留对亚极端比 Q/M 的完整依赖。两个四次不变量在两个非零通道中部分抵消，而作用量归一化场使引力电磁互易性显式化。跑动矩阵的局域极端极限在约定转换后重现相应的双不变量有效场论结果。允许独立四次耦合进一步表明，相同的电背景几何可以有不同的轴向跑动矩阵，并在指定的双算符模型中给出代数逆关系。该计算确定了最小耦合四次电动力学中的局域对数跑动；有限视界匹配响应需要额外的整体匹配计算。
classification.one_liner: 计算 Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg 黑洞在四次电磁修正下的四极对数潮汐响应，给出轴向跑动矩阵及其对 Q/M 的局域依赖。

2609.39468v1.title: Global Integrated Null Energy Contribution : Classification of Traversable Wormholes
2609.39468v1.abstract: We argue that the local violation of null energy condition at the throat of a traversable wormhole does not necessarily indicate that the total volume integrated null energy contribution is negative. It is already known that it can be arbitrarily close to zero. We show that it can even be positive and use this argument to reconstruct a family of wormhole geometries. We also propose a novel classification of traversable wormholes based on the global volume integrated measure of null energy condition.

classification.title_zh: 全局积分零能量贡献：可穿越虫洞的分类
classification.abstract_zh: 我们认为，可穿越虫洞喉部对零能量条件的局部违反并不一定意味着总体积积分的零能量贡献为负。已知它可以任意接近零。我们表明它甚至可以为正，并利用这一论证重构了一族虫洞几何。我们还提出了一种基于零能量条件全局体积积分度量的可穿越虫洞新分类。
classification.one_liner: 通过全局体积积分的零能量条件对可穿越虫洞进行分类，并表明其总积分贡献可为正。

2609.39598v1.title: The holographic QCD critical point is sensitive to quark flavors
2609.39598v1.abstract: We study the phase structure of dense QCD matter by applying the flavor-dependent holographic V-QCD model to two distinct physical environments: charge-neutral, beta-equilibrated matter, and strangeness-neutral matter with a fixed charge-to-baryon number ratio, n_Q/n_B = 0.4, relevant for heavy-ion collisions. The quark sector of the model incorporates the realistic mass hierarchy of two massless light quarks and a massive strange quark. We find that the resulting phase diagram depends sensitively on both the procedure used to tune the model against lattice QCD thermodynamics and the choice of physical environment. Using our preferred fitting procedure, we find that beta-equilibrated matter exhibits a first-order phase transition terminating at a critical endpoint located at significantly lower densities than in earlier holographic studies. However, this phase transition disappears entirely under heavy-ion conditions. This pronounced environmental dependence may help explain why recent net-proton cumulant measurements from Phase II of the RHIC Beam Energy Scan have not yet revealed clear non-monotonic fluctuation signatures. We calculate higher-order baryon number cumulant ratios along the chemical freeze-out curve to quantitatively compare the model predictions with experimental data. Finally, we also present global phase diagrams obtained by matching V-QCD to Hadron Resonance Gas models implemented in the Thermal-FIST package, and argue that this comparison further supports the conclusions drawn from the V-QCD model alone.

classification.title_zh: 全息 QCD 临界点对夸克味道敏感
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过将味道依赖的全息 V-QCD 模型应用于两种不同的物理环境，研究致密 QCD 物质的相结构：电荷中性、β 平衡物质，以及电荷与重子数比固定为 n_Q/n_B = 0.4 的奇异数中性物质，后者与重离子碰撞相关。模型的夸克部分包含了两个无质量轻夸克和一个有质量奇异夸克的现实质量层级。我们发现所得相图敏感地依赖于用于根据格点 QCD 热力学调参模型的方法以及物理环境的选择。使用我们偏好的拟合方法，我们发现 β 平衡物质表现出一个一阶相变，终止于临界端点，其密度显著低于早前的全息研究。然而，在重离子条件下该相变完全消失。这种显著的环境依赖性可能有助于解释为何 RHIC 束流能量扫描 II 期最近的净质子累积量测量尚未揭示清晰的非单调涨落信号。我们沿化学冻结曲线计算高阶重子数累积量比，以定量比较模型预言与实验数据。最后，我们还展示了通过将 V-QCD 与 Thermal-FIST 包中实现的强子共振气体模型匹配得到的全局相图，并论证这一比较进一步支持仅从 V-QCD 模型得出的结论。
classification.one_liner: 味道依赖全息 V-QCD 表明致密 QCD 相图与临界端点强烈依赖重子/奇异数环境和拟合方法，重离子条件下相变可消失。

2609.39694v1.title: Gravitational Memory: an approximate description
2609.39694v1.abstract: The large-distance behaviour of a sandwich gravitational wave can be approximated by a continuous but not necessarily smooth profile, providing us with a simplified description of particle motion. Our approximate model is consistent with the Carroll symmetry. Our strategy is illustrated by the Poschl-Teller profile.

classification.title_zh: 引力记忆：一种近似描述
classification.abstract_zh: 三明治引力波的大距离行为可由连续但未必光滑的剖面近似，从而为粒子运动提供简化描述。我们的近似模型与 Carroll 对称性一致。我们用 Pöschl-Teller 剖面说明这一策略。
classification.one_liner: 用连续但未必光滑的剖面近似三明治引力波的大距离行为，以简化粒子运动，并与 Carroll 对称性保持一致。

2509.01925v2.title: Time-like Janus Solution -- holographic global quantum quench --
2509.01925v2.abstract: We construct a time-like Janus solution, which is mediated by a time-dependent dilaton field in asymptotic AdS spacetime. This solution breaks the null energy condition, but we argue that it is nevertheless useful as a toy model of holographic global quantum quench. The dual CFT is given by conformal perturbation theory, where the primary scalar operator that is dual to the bulk dilaton field is coupled with a global-quench-type time-dependent source. We compute one-point functions of the scalar operator and the stress-energy tensor, and confirm that the results are consistent with the proposed CFT picture. We also evaluate the holographic entanglement entropy for late time after the global quench. Finite temperature version of the solution, which can be interpreted as a time-dependent black hole, is also discussed.

classification.title_zh: 类时 Janus 解——全息全局量子淬火
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了一个类时 Janus 解，它由渐近 AdS 时空中的含时 dilaton 场中介。该解破坏零能条件，但我们论证它仍可作为全息全局量子淬火的玩具模型。对偶 CFT 由共形微扰论给出，其中与体 dilaton 场对偶的标量主算符耦合到一个全局淬火型含时源。我们计算该标量算符和能动张量的一点函数，并确认结果与所提出的 CFT 图像一致。我们还计算了全局淬火后晚时刻的全息纠缠熵。最后讨论了该解的有限温度版本，可解释为含时黑洞。
classification.one_liner: 构造破坏零能条件的类时 Janus 解，作为 AdS/CFT 中全局量子淬火的玩具模型，并计算一点函数与全息纠缠熵。

2511.21851v2.title: ADE Minimal Strings and Multi-Matrix Duals
2511.21851v2.abstract: We revisit ADE minimal string theories, focusing on the D- and E-series minimal models coupled to Liouville theory. Unlike the A-series, whose duals are solvable two-matrix models, these theories are conjectured to correspond to unsolvable four-matrix integrals. We compute sphere four-point and torus one-point amplitudes in the AMS, DMS, and EMS via direct numerical integration over moduli space, confirming/disproving some known results and providing new data where matrix-model predictions are unavailable. For torus one-point amplitudes, we also present conjectural analytic formulas consistent with all our numerical checks. From amplitudes with conformal boundaries, we find evidence for multi-matrix structure in the D-series, including scaled ramp behavior in cylinder diagrams and deviations from the ZZ-instanton sector of two-matrix models. We also perform a preliminary positivity bootstrap to constrain critical points of the multi-matrix models relevant to the DMS string.

classification.title_zh: ADE 极小弦与多矩阵对偶
classification.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视 ADE 极小弦理论，重点关注与 Liouville 理论耦合的 D 系列和 E 系列极小模型。与 A 系列不同——其对偶是可解的双矩阵模型——这些理论被猜想对应于不可解的四矩阵积分。我们通过对模空间直接数值积分，计算了 AMS、DMS 和 EMS 中的球面四点振幅和环面单点振幅，证实/否证了一些已知结果，并在矩阵模型预言不可用之处提供了新数据。对于环面单点振幅，我们还给出了与所有数值检验一致的猜想解析公式。从带共形边界的振幅中，我们发现 D 系列存在多矩阵结构的证据，包括柱面图中的标度化斜坡行为，以及偏离双矩阵模型的 ZZ 瞬子扇区。我们还进行了初步的正性 bootstrap，以约束与 DMS 弦相关的多矩阵模型的临界点。
classification.one_liner: 通过数值与解析方法研究 D/E 系列极小弦的球面/环面振幅，寻找其四矩阵对偶及多矩阵结构证据。

2602.02644v2.title: Carrollian Physics and Holography
2602.02644v2.abstract: This report reviews key developments in Carrollian physics with an emphasis on their role in the emerging framework of holography in asymptotically flat spacetimes. We begin by introducing the Carrollian limit, understood as a contraction of the Poincar\'e group obtained by formally taking the speed of light to zero. The geometric structures associated with this limit are described and argued to arise naturally on null hypersurfaces, most notably on null infinity, as well as black hole and cosmological horizons. Building on this, we examine the relation between the Bondi-Metzner-Sachs symmetries governing asymptotically flat gravity and the conformal Carrollian symmetries. Explicit examples of Carrollian field theories are constructed by implementing the limit on well-known relativistic field theories, with particular attention to Carrollian CFTs. We then present the Carrollian holography proposal, according to which gravity in asymptotically flat spacetimes is dual to a Carrollian CFT living at null infinity in one lower dimension. In this framework, the massless $\mathcal{S}$-matrix written in position space at null infinity is naturally reinterpreted in terms of boundary Carrollian CFT correlators, called Carrollian amplitudes. We highlight their relation to celestial amplitudes and show how they naturally emerge from holographic CFT correlators through a correspondence between the flat space limit in the bulk and the Carrollian limit at the boundary. Using this correspondence, we provide strong evidence that flat space holography arises from a controlled and consistent limiting procedure applied to both sides of the AdS/CFT duality. We conclude by outlining future directions and open questions in the program.

classification.title_zh: Carrollian 物理与全息
classification.abstract_zh: 本报告综述了 Carrollian 物理的关键进展，重点讨论其在渐近平直时空新兴全息框架中的作用。我们首先引入 Carrollian 极限，即通过形式上令光速趋于零而得到的 Poincaré 群收缩。描述了与该极限相关的几何结构，并论证它们自然出现在零超曲面，尤其是零无穷，以及黑洞和宇宙学视界上。在此基础上，我们考察支配渐近平直引力的 Bondi-Metzner-Sachs 对称性与共形 Carrollian 对称性之间的关系。通过对已知相对论场论实施该极限，构造了 Carrollian 场论的具体例子，特别关注 Carrollian CFT。随后介绍 Carrollian 全息提议：渐近平直时空中的引力对偶于生活在低一维零无穷上的 Carrollian CFT。在此框架中，写在零无穷位置空间的无质量 S 矩阵被自然地重新解释为边界 Carrollian CFT 关联函数，称为 Carrollian 振幅。我们强调它们与天球振幅的关系，并展示它们如何通过体时空平直极限与边界 Carrollian 极限之间的对应关系，自然地从全息 CFT 关联函数中出现。利用这一对应关系，我们提供有力证据表明平直空间全息源于将受控且一致的极限过程应用于 AdS/CFT 对偶的两侧。最后概述该纲领的未来方向和开放问题。
classification.one_liner: 综述 Carrollian 物理及其在渐近平直时空全息中的应用，并论证平直空间全息可从 AdS/CFT 的双侧极限导出。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于平直时空全息/BMS-Carroll 方向，与 AdS/CFT 极限相关，但不直接匹配用户重点标签中的凝聚态、探针膜、冷原子、相变或经典引力等支线，故相关性中等。

2602.22335v2.title: Resurgence in the Virasoro Minimal String and 3d Gravity
2602.22335v2.abstract: We compute non-perturbative, resurgent contributions to the Virasoro minimal string and 3d gravity using techniques from hermitian matrix models. In particular, we construct a fully non-perturbative partition function for the Virasoro minimal string in terms of a Zak transform. In this context, negative tension D-branes appear naturally, which in the matrix model correspond to anti-eigenvalues, or instantons on the involuted sheet of the spectral curve. We further extend this analysis to resolvents and observe resurgent wall crossing phenomena between ZZ- and FZZT-branes. Using recent results that relate the Virasoro minimal string to 3d gravity with end-of-the-world branes we proceed to study the resurgent consequences of summing over the genus in 3d gravity, where we find non-perturbative contributions of doubly exponential type. These statements are then tested using resurgent large-order asymptotics. Lastly, we compute the non-perturbative eigenvalue density for generic hermitian matrix models and identify the change of asymptotic behavior at the edge of the eigenvalue distribution with a Stokes transition. This allows us to identify oscillations in the eigenvalue density with anti-Stokes behavior of FZZT-branes. In the case of 3d gravity with end-of-the-world branes we comment how this Stokes transition coincides with the onset of black hole behaviour and compute the non-perturbative primary density. Furthermore, we apply these techniques to the eigenvalue density of JT gravity to compute higher genus corrections.

classification.title_zh: Virasoro 极小弦与三维引力中的 Resurgence
classification.abstract_zh: 我们利用厄米矩阵模型技术，计算 Virasoro 极小弦和三维引力中的非微扰、resurgent 贡献。特别地，我们以 Zak 变换构造 Virasoro 极小弦的完全非微扰配分函数。在此语境中，负张力 D-膜自然出现，在矩阵模型中对应反本征值，或谱曲线对合片上的瞬子。我们进一步将分析推广到预解式，并观察到 ZZ-膜与 FZZT-膜之间的 resurgent 穿墙现象。利用最近将 Virasoro 极小弦与带世界尽头膜的三维引力联系起来的结果，我们研究三维引力中对亏格求和的 resurgent 后果，发现双指数型非微扰贡献。随后用 resurgent 大阶渐近检验这些论断。最后，我们计算一般厄米矩阵模型的非微扰本征值密度，并把本征值分布边缘处渐近行为的变化识别为 Stokes 相变。这使我们能把本征值密度中的振荡识别为 FZZT-膜的反 Stokes 行为。在带世界尽头膜的三维引力情形中，我们评论该 Stokes 相变如何与黑洞行为的出现一致，并计算非微扰主密度。此外，我们将这些技术应用于 JT 引力的本征值密度，以计算高亏格修正。
classification.one_liner: 通过矩阵模型 resurgence 技术研究 Virasoro 极小弦与带世界尽头膜的三维引力中的非微扰效应、Stokes 转变及 JT 引力高亏格修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文聚焦矩阵模型 resurgence、Virasoro 极小弦与 JT/三维引力，未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超导、p波、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子或 D3-D7 探针膜等支线。

2604.19920v2.title: Black Hole Interiors as a Laboratory for Time-Dependent Classical Double Copy
2604.19920v2.abstract: The classical double copy relates gravity and gauge theory, but its most explicit realizations remain concentrated in stationary or highly symmetric settings. We show that trapped regions of black-hole geometries provide an exact setting for time-dependent classical double copy. More generally, a class of Kantowski--Sachs cosmologies admits an intrinsic double-copy construction: the Kerr--Schild scalar and single-copy field are uniquely reconstructible from the cosmological metric alone, without prior knowledge that the spacetime is a black-hole interior or reference to any exterior completion. The reconstructed field admits both the standard flat-background Kerr--Schild realization and a complementary Maxwell realization on the Kantowski--Sachs geometry, where it describes a homogeneous, time-dependent electric field. We prove that this class is characterized by a relation between the Kantowski--Sachs scale factors equivalent to $p_{\parallel}=-\rho$. For Schwarzschild, the single-copy electric field diverges along the interior evolution, whereas for the regular Bardeen solution it remains finite throughout the trapped region and extends smoothly into the regular static core. The Bardeen geometry violates the strong energy condition in a compact central region, whereas the corresponding single-copy Maxwell field remains regular and satisfies the standard classical energy conditions. We further show that the Bardeen horizon phase structure is encoded in the single-copy scalar. Thus trapped Kerr--Schild interiors provide an exact local realization of time-dependent classical double copy.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞内部作为含时经典双拷贝的实验室
classification.abstract_zh: 经典双拷贝联系引力与规范理论，但其最显式的实现仍集中于稳态或高度对称情形。我们表明，黑洞几何的陷落区为含时经典双拷贝提供了精确设定。更一般地，一类 Kantowski–Sachs 宇宙学允许一种内禀双拷贝构造：仅从宇宙学度规即可唯一重构 Kerr–Schild 标量和单拷贝场，无需事先知道该时空是黑洞内部，也无需参考任何外部补全。重构出的场既允许标准平背景 Kerr–Schild 实现，也允许 Kantowski–Sachs 几何上的互补 Maxwell 实现，在其中描述一个均匀、含时的电场。我们证明该类由 Kantowski–Sachs 标度因子之间等价于 p∥ = -ρ 的关系刻画。对 Schwarzschild，单拷贝电场沿内部演化发散；而对正则 Bardeen 解，它在整个陷落区保持有限，并平滑延伸到正则静态核心。Bardeen 几何在一个紧致中心区域违反强能量条件，而对应的单拷贝 Maxwell 场保持正则并满足标准经典能量条件。我们进一步表明，Bardeen 的视界相结构编码在单拷贝标量中。因此，陷落的 Kerr–Schild 内部为含时经典双拷贝提供了精确的局部实现。
classification.one_liner: 论文证明黑洞陷落区及一类 Kantowski–Sachs 宇宙学可精确实现含时经典双拷贝，并给出 Schwarzschild 与 Bardeen 的单拷贝场行为。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究黑洞内部与经典双拷贝；不涉及全息，但与用户列出的经典引力重点标签直接对应。

2606.17171v2.title: Black hole equations of state and response functions
2606.17171v2.abstract: We systematically develop a framework for equilibrium thermodynamics in terms of thermodynamic representations, which are choices of thermodynamic potential and independent variables, one from each conjugate pair. In each representation, equations of state arise from first derivatives of the potential and response functions from its second derivatives. We apply this framework to ideal gases and to Schwarzschild black holes in a spherical cavity in various representations, interpreting the cavity area and its conjugate surface pressure as the thermodynamic volume and pressure of a holographically dual system. For this quasi-local Schwarzschild black hole, stability depends on the thermodynamic representation, or equivalently on which variables are held fixed under equilibrium perturbations. The large black hole branch is thermally stable at fixed volume but mechanically unstable under isothermal compression, while the system is mechanically stable under adiabatic compression everywhere. At fixed pressure, the black hole is thermally unstable throughout the physical state space. We also find that the thermal expansion coefficient is negative everywhere and show that isenthalpic expansion always cools the black hole. More broadly, the framework provides a systematic route to deriving equations of state and response functions for a wide class of black hole systems using quasi-local gravitational thermodynamics.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞态方程与响应函数
classification.abstract_zh: 我们系统发展了一个平衡热力学框架，其基于热力学表示，即选择热力学势以及每个共轭对中的一个独立变量。在每种表示中，态方程来自势的一阶导数，响应函数来自势的二阶导数。我们将该框架应用于理想气体以及球腔中的 Schwarzschild 黑洞，在多种表示下，把腔面积及其共轭表面压力解释为全息对偶系统的热力学体积和压力。对于这个准局域 Schwarzschild 黑洞，稳定性取决于热力学表示，或等价地取决于平衡微扰下哪些变量被固定。大黑洞分支在固定体积下热稳定，但在等温压缩下力学不稳定，而系统在绝热压缩下处处力学稳定。在固定压力下，黑洞在整个物理状态空间热不稳定。我们还发现热膨胀系数处处为负，并表明等焓膨胀总是冷却黑洞。更广泛地，该框架为使用准局域引力热力学推导一大类黑洞系统的态方程和响应函数提供了系统途径。
classification.one_liner: 通过热力学表示系统推导黑洞态方程与响应函数，并分析准局域 Schwarzschild 黑洞的稳定性。

2606.24328v5.title: Dark-Sector Bicriticality in Hyperscaling-Violating Holographic Superfluids
2606.24328v5.abstract: We show analytically that a dark-scalar order can preempt anisotropic $p$-wave order in a gauge-invariant hyperscaling-violating holographic superfluid. Near a point where the source-free scalar and vector instabilities coincide, their grand potentials can be compared in closed perturbative form. The homogeneous coexistence solution is a saddle, so the preferred state switches directly between an anisotropic vector-condensed phase and an isotropic dark-scalar-condensed phase across a first-order line. This line terminates where the two continuous normal-to-ordered transition lines meet, producing a bicritical point. A joint hyperscaling/Lifshitz deformation moves the bicritical point, showing that nonconformal infrared scaling can select not only the critical scale but also the spatial symmetry of the preferred ordered phase. Entanglement anisotropy follows the squared vector order and therefore jumps to zero when the dark-scalar phase takes over. The result provides a controlled dark-Higgs-motivated mechanism for ordered-to-ordered symmetry conversion at leading probe order.

classification.title_zh: 超尺度破坏全息超流体中的暗扇区双临界性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过解析方法表明，在规范不变的、破坏超尺度的全息超流体中，暗标量序可以抢先于各向异性 p 波序。在无源标量和矢量不稳定性重合的点附近，可以以闭式微扰形式比较它们的大势。均匀共存解是一个鞍点，因此优选态会跨过一条一阶线，直接在各向异性矢量凝聚相和各向同性暗标量凝聚相之间切换。这条线终止于两条连续的正常到有序转变线相交处，产生一个双临界点。联合的超尺度/Lifshitz 形变会移动双临界点，表明非共形红外标度不仅能选择临界尺度，还能选择优选有序相的空间对称性。纠缠各向异性跟随矢量序的平方，因此当暗标量相接管时跳变为零。该结果提供了一种受控的、由暗希格斯启发的机制，用于在主导探针阶实现有序到有序的对称性转换。
classification.one_liner: 在全息超流体中，暗标量序可抢占 p 波序，形成双临界点并改变优选有序相的空间对称性。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究全息超流体中的 p 波与暗标量序竞争、双临界和相变，契合用户全息超流超导、p 波/多分量序参量与相变重点；涉及超尺度破坏红外标度。

2606.25613v2.title: Holographic correlation functions of fermions in anisotropic plasma
2606.25613v2.abstract: By using the gauge-gravity duality, we study the holographic fermionic correlation functions in strongly coupled anisotropic plasmas. Starting from the isotropic AdS-Schwarzschild black brane background, we revisit the prescription for computing the retarded Green's function of a probe Dirac fermion and then generalize the formulas with respect to the anisotropic geometries. The method is applied to three distinct holographic models that capture different physical origins of anisotropy: axion-induced, magnetic-field-induced and unquenched-flavor-induced. Numerical results for the holographic correlation functions reveal direction-dependent corrections, negative dips in the imaginary part, Landau levels in the fermionic dispersion (magnetic field), and a momentum-independent pseudogap indicating an incoherent metallic phase (flavors). Our results complement and go beyond the hard thermal loop approximation, providing non-perturbative insights into fermionic excitations in strongly coupled anisotropic plasmas relevant for heavy-ion collisions and certain condensed matter systems.

classification.title_zh: 各向异性等离子体中费米子的全息关联函数
classification.abstract_zh: 利用规范-引力对偶，我们研究强耦合各向异性等离子体中的全息费米子关联函数。从各向同性 AdS-Schwarzschild 黑膜背景出发，我们重新审视探针狄拉克费米子延迟格林函数的计算方案，并将公式推广到各向异性几何。该方法应用于三种不同的全息模型，分别捕捉各向异性的不同物理起源：轴子诱导、磁场诱导和未淬火味诱导。全息关联函数的数值结果揭示了方向依赖修正、虚部负凹陷、费米子色散中的朗道能级（磁场）以及动量无关的赝能隙，表明非相干金属相（味）。我们的结果补充并超越了硬热圈近似，为强耦合各向异性等离子体中的费米子激发提供了非微扰洞察，与重离子碰撞及某些凝聚态系统相关。
classification.one_liner: 在规范/引力对偶下计算强耦合各向异性等离子体中探针费米子的全息关联函数，并比较轴子、磁场和味诱导三种各向异性来源。

2607.06236v2.title: Schwarzschild black holes from twistor space
2607.06236v2.abstract: Twistor theory forms the basis for many surprising advances in areas ranging from dynamical systems to quantum field theory. Yet for almost fifty years, one of the main drawbacks of twistor theory has been its inability to give non-perturbative descriptions of non-chiral (or non-self-dual) field configurations. This difficulty is known as `the googly problem.' In this paper, we provide a resolution of the googly problem for a particular solution of the vacuum Einstein equations: the Schwarzschild metric. We start with the twistor space of the self-dual Taub-NUT Euclidean gravitational instanton, expressed in Kerr-Schild form. Within this twistor space, we then consider a quadric which corresponds to the anti-self-dual Taub-NUT metric. While the full quadric is not holomorphic with respect to the complex structure of the self-dual Taub-NUT twistor space, its holomorphic locus still has complex dimension two. This `coincidence locus' -- points in twistor space on the holomorphic portion of the quadric -- inherits a complex structure from the twistor space and a symplectic form from the quadric itself. Remarkably, these structures are compatible, giving rise to a non-self-dual, four-dimensional K\"ahler metric which is conformal to Schwarzschild (in Lorentzian or Euclidean signature). This is the first instance of a non-self-dual Einstein metric constructed entirely from holomorphic data in a twistor space.

classification.title_zh: 从扭量空间构造 Schwarzschild 黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 扭量理论是动力学系统到量子场论等诸多领域许多惊人进展的基础。然而近五十年来，扭量理论的主要缺点之一是它无法给出非手征（或非自对偶）场构型的非微扰描述。这一困难被称为“googly 问题”。本文将针对真空 Einstein 方程的一个特定解——Schwarzschild 度规——给出该 googly 问题的一种解决。我们从以 Kerr-Schild 形式表达的自对偶 Taub-NUT 欧几里得引力瞬子的扭量空间出发。在这个扭量空间内，我们考虑一个对应于反自对偶 Taub-NUT 度规的二次曲面。虽然相对于自对偶 Taub-NUT 扭量空间的复结构而言，整个二次曲面并非全纯，但其全纯轨迹仍具有复维数二。这个“重合轨迹”——扭量空间中位于二次曲面全纯部分上的点——从扭量空间继承一个复结构，并从二次曲面本身继承一个辛形式。值得注意的是，这些结构相容，从而给出一个非自对偶的四维 Kähler 度规，它共形于 Schwarzschild（洛伦兹或欧几里得号差）。这是首次完全由扭量空间中的全纯数据构造出非自对偶 Einstein 度规。
classification.one_liner: 通过自对偶 Taub-NUT 扭量空间中的全纯重合轨迹，构造出共形于 Schwarzschild 的非自对偶 Kähler 度规，从而在特定情形下解决 googly 问题。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论，研究真空 Einstein 方程的 Schwarzschild 解及扭量空间构造，并明确使用经典引力重点标签；不涉及全息 AdS/CFT。

2608.23111v2.title: A Third-Quantized Description of Spacetime Wormholes in AdS/CFT
2608.23111v2.abstract: We propose an extension of AdS/CFT in which quantum gravitational wavefunctions of connected bulk geometries are assembled into a Fock space of universes. Splitting and joining interactions in a third-quantized Hamiltonian then provide a quantum description of changes in bulk connectivity and topology. Reduced phase-space quantization supplies the physical one-universe Hilbert space and a radial Schr\"odinger evolution with respect to which the topology-changing interactions are ordered. We develop the construction concretely in AdS$_3$ gravity with a torus boundary, where these ingredients can be described explicitly. The light spectrum is treated as fixed, non-normalizable background data, whereas the normalizable states above the black-hole threshold are quantized as dynamical modes. A conventional boundary theory is selected by choosing a coherent state whose universe-field expectation value, together with the fixed background contribution, yields consistent CFT data at the asymptotic boundary. Generic one-universe wavefunctions need not admit such an interpretation. This raises the possibility that CFT-realizable wavefunctions are nongeneric in the gravitational state space and are not closed under arbitrary superpositions of gravitational states. The known two-torus spacetime-wormhole amplitude, which lies at the heart of the factorization problem, provides concrete input for the topology-changing interactions of the third-quantized theory. A complementary cutting-and-gluing description yields an effective ensemble interpretation when the resulting gravitational sectors admit consistent boundary-theory interpretations, without assuming a fundamental ensemble of boundary theories. We also discuss replica wormholes and baby-universe processes within the same framework.

classification.title_zh: AdS/CFT 中时空虫洞的第三量子化描述
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出 AdS/CFT 的一个扩展，其中连通体几何的量子引力波函数被组装成宇宙的 Fock 空间。第三量子化哈密顿量中的分裂与合并相互作用则给出体连通性和拓扑变化的量子描述。约化相空间量子化提供物理的单宇宙 Hilbert 空间以及径向 Schrödinger 演化，拓扑变化相互作用相对于该演化排序。我们在具有环面边界的 AdS3 引力中具体发展该构造，其中这些要素可以显式描述。轻谱被处理为固定的非归一化背景数据，而黑洞阈值以上的可归一化态被量子化为动力学模式。通过选择一个相干态来选定常规定界理论，其宇宙场期望值与固定背景贡献一起在渐近边界给出自洽的 CFT 数据。一般单宇宙波函数不必允许这种解释。这提出了一种可能性：CFT 可实现的波函数在引力态空间中是非一般的，并且对引力态的任意叠加不封闭。已知的双环面时空虫洞振幅——位于因子化问题核心——为第三量子化理论的拓扑变化相互作用提供了具体输入。当所得引力扇区允许自洽的边界理论解释时，互补的切割与粘合描述给出一种有效系综解释，而不假设边界理论的基本系综。我们还在同一框架内讨论复制虫洞和婴儿宇宙过程。
classification.one_liner: 提出将连通体几何波函数组装为宇宙 Fock 空间，用第三量子化哈密顿量描述 AdS/CFT 中体连通性与拓扑变化，并讨论虫洞振幅、因子化与有效系综解释。

2609.11643v2.title: Effective Dynamics of Inflationary End-of-the-World Branes in AdS$_3$
2609.11643v2.abstract: We develop an effective description of a two-dimensional cosmological end-of-the-world brane embedded in AdS$_3$, with a scalar field localized on the brane. Integrating out bulk degrees of freedom, especially in the small-gradient regime, the effective action reduces to a Liouville-like theory coupled to the brane scalar. We then construct brane trajectories whose induced geometry realizes slow-roll inflation and reconstruct the associated scalar profile and potential. We also study regular Euclidean brane geometries that admit a smooth continuation to Lorentzian de Sitter and inflationary universes, and evaluate the semiclassical on-shell action for the de Sitter solution. Finally, we analyze linearized inhomogeneous perturbations and find no exponentially growing mode within the regime of validity of the approximation.

classification.title_zh: AdS3 中暴胀端世界膜的有效动力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们为嵌入 AdS3 中的一个二维宇宙学端世界膜建立了有效描述，膜上局域有标量场。通过积掉体自由度，特别是在小梯度区域，有效作用量约化为与膜标量耦合的类 Liouville 理论。随后我们构造了其诱导几何实现慢滚暴胀的膜轨迹，并重构了相应的标量场剖面和势。我们还研究了允许光滑延拓到洛伦兹 de Sitter 和暴胀宇宙的正则欧几里得膜几何，并计算了 de Sitter 解的半经典 on-shell 作用量。最后，我们分析了线性化非均匀扰动，发现在该近似适用范围内没有指数增长模式。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS3 中构建端世界膜有效理论，得到类 Liouville 作用量，并实现慢滚暴胀与 dS 欧几里得延拓，线性扰动无指数增长。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究 AdS3 中端世界膜的有效动力学、慢滚暴胀和 de Sitter 延拓，属于膜世界宇宙学与经典引力范畴；与用户重点的全息超流超导、p 波、multi-trace、QNM 等凝聚态/全息支线无直接关系，仅通过“经典引力/广义相对论”标签有一定相关性。

2609.16980v2.title: Constraints on Kasner Exponents from Holography and Energy Conditions
2609.16980v2.abstract: A central question in bottom-up holography is whether a given bulk effective theory admits a consistent holographic dual. In this work, we explore whether the near-singularity Kasner scaling of planar AdS black hole interiors can serve as a useful diagnostic based on interior-sensitive holographic probes. By examining the metric combinations that control interior-sensitive observables, including Complexity=Volume (CV), the bulk contribution to Complexity=Action (CA), Hartman-Maldacena (HM) entropy, and the thermal $a$-function, we derive algebraic bounds on the Kasner exponents $(p_t,p_s)$ for the relevant semi-classical regimes: finite-radius late-time branches of CV and HM, finite CA complexity, and a finite near-singularity thermal $a$-function. The resulting inequalities delineate the corresponding regions of Kasner space in which the terminal scaling alone is sufficient to realize these behaviors. Furthermore, we demonstrate that classical energy conditions, specifically the null and dominant energy conditions, provide simple sufficient criteria ensuring that the Kasner exponents fall within these holographically allowed regions. These results establish a direct connection between classical bulk energy conditions and the interior geometry selected by holographic probes, and suggest that Kasner scaling can provide a complementary diagnostic in bottom-up holography.

classification.title_zh: 全息与能量条件对 Kasner 指数的约束
classification.abstract_zh: 自下而上全息中的一个核心问题是：给定的体有效理论是否容许一个自洽的全息对偶。本文探讨平面 AdS 黑洞内部的近奇点 Kasner 标度是否能作为一个有用的诊断，其依据是内部敏感的全息探针。通过考察控制内部敏感可观测量的度规组合，包括复杂度=体积（CV）、复杂度=作用量（CA）的体贡献、Hartman-Maldacena（HM）熵以及热 a-函数，我们为相关半经典区域推导了 Kasner 指数 (p_t,p_s) 的代数界：CV 与 HM 的有限半径晚时分支、有限 CA 复杂度、以及有限的近奇点热 a-函数。由此得到的不等式刻画了 Kasner 空间中相应区域，在这些区域内仅终端标度就足以实现这些行为。此外，我们证明经典能量条件，具体为零能量条件和主导能量条件，提供了简单充分判据，确保 Kasner 指数落在这些全息允许区域内。这些结果在经典体能条件与全息探针所选择的内部几何之间建立了直接联系，并表明 Kasner 标度可作为自下而上全息中的一种互补诊断。
classification.one_liner: 利用 CV/CA、HM 熵和热 a-函数等内部敏感全息探针给出 Kasner 指数的允许区域，并用经典能量条件给出充分判据。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于全息与黑洞内部诊断，涉及经典能量条件以及复杂度/HM 熵；与重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论相关，但不直接涉及全息超导、p波、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子等具体研究支线。

2609.20112v2.title: Supersymmetric boundary algebras in AdS$_3$ gravity: constraints, Dirac brackets and non-locality
2609.20112v2.abstract: We study supersymmetric boundary dynamics in AdS$_3$ gravity by treating boundary conditions as constrained reductions of a generic Chern-Simons boundary phase space. We focus on how the constraint structure controls the locality and physical field content of the reduced asymptotic symmetry algebra. For supersymmetric Kac--Moody boundary conditions, the surviving bosonic currents remain local, whereas the fermion--fermion Dirac bracket contains the inverse of a field-dependent first-order differential operator and is therefore intrinsically non-local. Imposing an additional fermionic constraint reveals a further structure: after the bosonic second-class reduction, it becomes first class and generates a fermionic gauge redundancy. Generically the remaining fermionic field can be gauged away, while special backgrounds with periodic zero modes support non-trivial physical fermionic sectors. We further employ the Batalin--Fradkin--Tyutin formalism to eliminate the non-locality of the reduced symmetry algebra by converting the second-class constraints into an equivalent local first-class system on an enlarged phase space.

classification.title_zh: AdS$_3$引力中的超对称边界代数：约束、狄拉克括号与非局域性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们通过将边界条件视为一般 Chern-Simons 边界相空间的约束约化，研究 AdS$_3$ 引力中的超对称边界动力学。我们关注约束结构如何控制约化后渐近对称代数的局域性和物理场内容。对于超对称 Kac--Moody 边界条件，幸存的玻色流保持局域，而费米子--费米子狄拉克括号包含一个依赖于场的一阶微分算子的逆，因此本质上是非局域的。施加额外的费米子约束揭示进一步结构：在玻色第二类约化之后，它变成第一类并生成费米规范冗余。一般情况下剩余费米子场可以被规范掉，而具有周期零模的特殊背景支持非平凡的物理费米子扇区。我们进一步采用 Batalin--Fradkin--Tyutin 形式，通过将第二类约束转换为扩大相空间上等价的局域第一类系统，来消除约化对称代数的非局域性。
classification.one_liner: 在 AdS$_3$ 引力中，将超对称边界条件视为 Chern-Simons 边界相空间的约束约化，考察约束如何导致渐近对称代数的非局域性及 Batalin-Fradkin-Tyutin 局域化处理。

2609.29590v2.title: Unification of Einstein Gravity with Internal Interactions
2609.29590v2.abstract: The gauge-theoretic formulation of gravity, enriched with the observation that the tangent group of a curved manifold need not have the same dimension as the manifold itself, provides a natural framework for unifying gravity with internal interactions. In the present work we study the unification of Einstein gravity with the $SO(10)$ grand unified theory within an $SO(1,17)$ gauge theory. As a central result, we derive Einstein gravity with a cosmological constant from the spontaneous symmetry breaking (SSB) of an $SO(1,5)$ gauge theory to the Lorentz group via two independent routes: one using two scalar fields in the fundamental representation $\mathbf{6}$ of $SO(6)$, and one using a single scalar in the adjoint $\mathbf{15}$. Both yield a Gauss-Bonnet + Einstein-Hilbert + cosmological constant action. Embedding the $SO(1,5)$ gravitational sector in $SO(1,17)$ and breaking the full gauge group yields Einstein gravity coupled to $SO(10)$. The Weyl-Majorana condition reduces the fermion family degeneracy to two, in contrast to the four families obtained in the $SO(2,16)$ conformal gravity unification.

classification.title_zh: 爱因斯坦引力与内部相互作用的统一
classification.abstract_zh: 引力的规范理论表述，加之弯曲流形的切群不必与流形本身同维这一观察，为统一引力与内部相互作用提供了自然框架。在本工作中，我们在一个 SO(1,17) 规范理论中研究爱因斯坦引力与 SO(10) 大统一理论的统一。作为核心结果，我们通过两条独立路径，从 SO(1,5) 规范理论到洛伦兹群的自发对称破缺（SSB）导出了带宇宙学常数的爱因斯坦引力：一条使用 SO(6) 基本表示 6 中的两个标量场，另一条使用伴随表示 15 中的单个标量。两者都给出 Gauss-Bonnet + Einstein-Hilbert + 宇宙学常数作用量。将 SO(1,5) 引力部分嵌入 SO(1,17) 并破缺整个规范群，得到与 SO(10) 耦合的爱因斯坦引力。Weyl-Majorana 条件将费米子代简并度约化为两代，而 SO(2,16) 共形引力统一中得到的是四代。
classification.one_liner: 在 SO(1,17) 规范理论中通过自发对称破缺导出带宇宙学常数的爱因斯坦引力，并与 SO(10) 大统一耦合。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文不属于全息 AdS/CFT 研究，但直接讨论经典爱因斯坦引力作用量的规范理论导出，并与用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论部分相关。

2609.30362v2.title: Informational and algebraic renormalization group
2609.30362v2.abstract: Renormalization group (RG) is a core concept in physics from statistical mechanics to quantum field theory, yet its schemes differ widely between field theory and many-body physics. We formulate the Wilsonian RG as a quantum channel, whose Kraus representation yields pure conditional trajectories for pure inputs and recovers mixed-state flows upon averaging. We then develop an algebraic extension applicable beyond the usual momentum-space, factorized setting: the low-energy algebra is constructed from the one-particle spectrum, and coarse graining is a conditional expectation onto it. We further construct a resource theory of RG whose free states are fixed points. For thermal states, the resulting relative-entropy monotone is proportional to $c-c_{\rm IR}$ to quadratic order along a single stable RG direction near a two-dimensional IR fixed point. We also introduce a complementary measure of the UV information discarded by coarse graining, establish its monotonicity for successive coarse-graining maps, and discuss its holographic realization.

classification.title_zh: 信息论与代数重整化群
classification.abstract_zh: 重整化群（RG）是从统计力学到量子场论的核心概念，但其方案在场论与多体物理之间差异很大。我们将 Wilsonian RG 表述为一个量子信道，其 Kraus 表示对纯输入给出纯条件轨迹，并在平均后恢复混合态流。随后我们发展了一个代数扩展，适用于通常的动量空间、因子化设定之外的情形：低能代数由单粒子谱构造，粗粒化是到该代数的条件期望。我们进一步构造了 RG 的资源理论，其自由态是不动点。对于热态，所得的相对熵单调量在二维红外不动点附近沿单一稳定 RG 方向到二次阶时正比于 c-c_IR。我们还引入了粗粒化所丢弃的紫外信息的互补度量，建立了其在逐次粗粒化映射下的单调性，并讨论了它的全息实现。
classification.one_liner: 将 Wilsonian RG 表述为量子信道并发展代数与资源理论，讨论其全息实现。

2609.37269v2.title: Active normal-fluid feedback in quantum turbulence from holography
2609.37269v2.abstract: The two-fluid model provides a powerful phenomenological framework for superfluids, where components interact through vortex-induced mutual friction. Quantum turbulence in such coupled two-fluid systems has become a central theme in low-temperature physics. However, the fundamental incompatibility between discrete vortex-line and continuum descriptions has historically forced reliance on phenomenological parameters. Here, we present an ab initio holographic simulation of this active two-fluid dynamics. Using a fully backreacted gravitational model, we intrinsically incorporate reciprocal momentum exchange and finite-temperature dissipation without empirical inputs. Contrasting continuously driven and freely decaying turbulence, we uncover pronounced non-Gaussian tails and spatial anisotropy in the normal-fluid velocity statistics, arising directly from the dynamical quantized vortex backreaction. Raising the temperature suppresses normal-fluid velocity fluctuations despite increasing the vortex density. This suppression is unambiguously traced to the thermal depletion of the superfluid condensate. Our results establish holographic duality as a rigorous first-principles framework for quantum turbulence, revealing the active role of the normal fluid far from equilibrium and yielding predictions for ongoing cold-atom and superfluid experiments.

classification.title_zh: 全息中量子湍流的主动正常流体反馈
classification.abstract_zh: 双流体模型为超流体提供了强有力的唯象框架，其中各组分通过涡旋诱导的互摩擦相互作用。此类耦合双流体系统中的量子湍流已成为低温物理的核心主题。然而，离散涡线和连续场描述之间的根本不相容，历来迫使人们依赖唯象参数。这里，我们提出了对这种主动双流体动力学的从头算全息模拟。使用完全包含反作用的引力模型，我们在没有经验输入的情况下内在地纳入互易动量交换和有限温度耗散。对比连续驱动和自由衰减湍流，我们揭示了正常流体速度统计中显著的非高斯尾和空间各向异性，它们直接来自动态量子化涡旋的反作用。升高温度会抑制正常流体速度涨落，尽管涡旋密度增加。这种抑制被明确追溯到超流凝聚体的热耗竭。我们的结果确立了全息对偶作为量子湍流的严格第一性原理框架，揭示了正常流体远离平衡时的主动作用，并为正在进行的冷原子和超流实验提供了预测。
classification.one_liner: 利用完全反作用的全息引力模型从头算模拟超流双流体量子湍流，揭示正常流体的非高斯、各向异性涨落及其热抑制，并为冷原子实验提供预测。

2211.13233v2.title: Slow-roll inflation in $f\left(R, T, R_{ab}T^{ab}\right)$ gravity
2211.13233v2.abstract: In the framework of $f\left(R, T, R_{ab}T^{ab}\right)$ gravity theory, the slow-roll approximation of the cosmic inflation is investigated, where $T$ is the trace of the energy-momentum tensor $T^{ab}$, $R$ and $R_{ab}$ are the Ricci scalar and tensor, respectively. After obtaining the equations of motion of the gravitational field from the action principle in the spatially flat FLRW metric, the fundamental equations of this theory are received by introducing the inflation scalar field as the matter and taking into account only the minimum curvature-inflation coupling term. Remarkably, after taking the slow-roll approximation, the identical equations as in $f(R, T)$ gravity with a $RT$ mixing term are derived. We study several potentials of interest in different domains. We perform analytical analyzes under various approximate conditions, and present numerical results and their comparison with existing observational data at the same time. In the appendix, we analyze the behavior of the inflation scalar field under perturbation while ignoring the effect of metric perturbations. This research complements the slow-roll inflation in the modified theory of gravity.

classification.title_zh: f(R,T,R_{ab}T^{ab}) 引力中的慢滚暴胀
classification.abstract_zh: 在 f(R,T,R_{ab}T^{ab}) 引力理论框架下，研究了宇宙暴胀的慢滚近似，其中 T 是能量动量张量 T^{ab} 的迹，R 和 R_{ab} 分别是 Ricci 标量和张量。在空间平坦 FLRW 度规下由作用量原理得到引力场运动方程后，通过引入暴胀标量场作为物质并只考虑最小曲率-暴胀耦合项，得到该理论的基本方程。值得注意的是，在采用慢滚近似后，导出了与带有 RT 混合项的 f(R,T) 引力中相同的方程。我们研究了不同领域中若干感兴趣的势。我们在各种近似条件下进行解析分析，同时给出数值结果及其与现有观测数据的比较。在附录中，我们在忽略度规扰动影响的情况下分析了暴胀标量场在扰动下的行为。本研究补充了修改引力理论中的慢滚暴胀。
classification.one_liner: 在 f(R,T,R_{ab}T^{ab}) 修改引力中研究暴胀慢滚近似，并给出解析与数值观测约束。

2605.18186v2.title: Consistency Conditions for Astrons
2605.18186v2.abstract: We reassess the consistency conditions for a hypothetical population of primordial, electrically charged compact objects, here called astrons. This paper formulates astrons not as a completed model, but as a set of quantitative consistency tests for a primordial large-charge compact-object scenario. The fiducial phenomenological parameters, \(M_A\sim10^{12}M_\odot\), \(Q_A\sim4\times10^{32}\,\mathrm{C}\), and megaparsec-scale separations, are treated as a benchmark to be tested rather than as an established outcome of the model. We show explicitly that ordinary accretion-driven charge separation produces charges only of order \(10^{11}\)--\(10^{14}\,\mathrm C\) for this mass, leaving an 18--21 order-of-magnitude gap relative to the fiducial branch. Thus the large-charge branch, if it exists, must arise from a primordial charge-concentration mechanism not supplied by the minimal capture model. Likewise, the failure of linear Debye--H\"uckel screening in the enormous electrostatic potential of an astron does not demonstrate charge survival; it identifies a nonlinear neutralization and kinetic-transport problem. Finally, a cosmologically relevant abundance of \(10^{12}M_\odot\) compact objects requires mean separations of several megaparsecs and must satisfy discreteness, Poisson-power, clustering, and dynamical constraints. The homogeneous Coulomb interaction energy scales as \(a^{-4}\), so it cannot by itself act as a late-time cosmological constant. \begin{refone}Moreover, the Lorentz force acts directly only on charged astrons, not on the no-net-charge population of galaxies, photons and neutral dark matter. Any viable cosmological implementation must therefore derive a metric-level or domain-averaged acceleration shared by the neutral cosmic flow, rather than merely a pairwise repulsion among charged sources.

classification.title_zh: Astrons 的一致性条件
classification.abstract_zh: 我们重新评估一种假想原初、带电致密天体（这里称为 astrons）族群的一致性条件。本文将 astrons 不是作为一个完整模型，而是作为原初大电荷致密天体情景的一组定量一致性检验来表述。基准唯象参数 M_A~10^12 M_⊙、Q_A~4×10^32 C 以及兆秒差距尺度间距被视为待检验的基准，而不是模型已确立的结果。我们明确显示，对于该质量，普通吸积驱动的电荷分离只产生约 10^11–10^14 C 的电荷，相对于基准分支留下 18–21 个数量级的差距。因此，大电荷分支如果存在，必须来自最小捕获模型未提供的原初电荷集中机制。同样，在 astron 的巨大静电势中线性 Debye-Hückel 屏蔽失效，并不能证明电荷存活；它指认了一个非线性中和与动理学输运问题。最后，10^12 M_⊙ 致密天体的宇宙学相关丰度要求平均间距为若干兆秒差距，并必须满足离散性、泊松功率、成团性和动力学约束。均匀库仑相互作用能按 a^{-4} 标度，因此它本身不能充当晚期宇宙学常数。此外，洛伦兹力只直接作用于带电 astrons，而不作用于净电荷为零的星系、光子和中性暗物质族群。任何可行的宇宙学实现都必须导出由中性宇宙流共享的度规层面或域平均加速度，而不只是带电源之间的成对排斥。
classification.one_liner: 本文将假想原初大电荷致密天体 astrons 表述为定量一致性检验，并指出标准吸积电荷分离、线性屏蔽及宇宙学/动力学约束之间存在巨大缺口。

2606.17084v2.title: Perfect fluids revisited: an action principle approach
2606.17084v2.abstract: We revisit the variational principle for relativistic perfect fluids in a manifestly covariant formulation based on differential forms, with particular attention to the boundary data required for a well-posed action principle. For timelike flows, the formulation reproduces the standard formulation of Schutz and Brown. We then examine the extension obtained by replacing proper time normalization of the velocity with a nullity constraint, with the he Bi{\v c}{\'a}k-Kucha{\v r} null dust action emerging as a special case. Requiring the complete action to be invariant under local rescalings of the null flow vector imposes the condition that the energy density depend only on the entropy per particle. For this class of null flows, the conventional equilibrium condition, \textit{i.e.}, that the energy density is convex, fails at non-zero temperatures, therefore limiting the interpretation of the fluid as an ordinary thermodynamic system.

classification.title_zh: 重新审视完美流体：一种作用量原理方法
classification.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视相对论性完美流体的变分原理，采用基于微分形式的显式协变表述，并特别关注使作用量原理适定所需的边界数据。对于类时流，该表述复现 Schutz 与 Brown 的标准表述。随后我们研究把速度的固有时归一化替换为零性约束所得的推广，其中 Bičák-Kuchař 零尘埃作用量作为特例出现。要求完整作用量在零性流矢量的局域重标度下保持不变，会施加能量密度仅依赖于每粒子熵的条件。对于这类零性流，通常的平衡条件——能量密度为凸——在非零温度下失效，从而限制了将流体解释为普通热力学系统。
classification.one_liner: 以微分形式重新表述相对论完美流体的作用量原理，并指出零性流推广中热力学凸性条件失效。

2606.17983v2.title: Emergent de Sitter Space and Non-Unitary Tensor Networks from Non-Hermitian Quantum Criticality
2606.17983v2.abstract: Extending the holographic principle to de Sitter (dS) spacetimes remains one of the most vital open frontiers in quantum gravity, where a microscopic, bottom-up tensor-network framework that relates boundary quantum data to emergent de Sitter spacetime is still lacking. In this work, we first show the emergence of de Sitter spacetime from boundary entanglement by formulating a non-unitary continuous multi-scale entanglement renormalization ansatz (cMERA) for a concrete non-Hermitian critical fermion chain. Within this emergent spacetime, we analyze the associated geodesics and show that they act as extremal Ryu-Takayanagi (RT) surfaces undergoing a smooth timelike-to-null transition. Remarkably, we demonstrate that this continuum trajectory suggests a distinct tensor-network architecture in which the bond-counting contribution naturally truncates at the discrete timelike-to-null transition toward the deep infrared. In the resulting architecture, the null ray along the horizon is represented by zero-cost links, since the associated cut severs no tensor legs. This network structure successfully reproduces the logarithmic scaling of non-unitary critical entanglement entropy, offering a bond-counting picture for the de Sitter RT formula. Our results provide the long-sought dS/(c)MERA correspondence at the level of both emergent spacetime and discrete holographic entanglement.

classification.title_zh: 从非厄米量子临界性涌现的 de Sitter 空间与非幺正张量网络
classification.abstract_zh: 将全息原理推广到 de Sitter（dS）时空仍然是量子引力中最重要的开放前沿之一，目前仍缺乏一个微观、自下而上的张量网络框架，将边界量子数据与涌现的 de Sitter 时空联系起来。在这项工作中，我们首先通过为具体的非厄米临界费米子链构造非幺正连续多尺度纠缠重正化拟设（cMERA），展示了 de Sitter 时空从边界纠缠中的涌现。在这个涌现时空中，我们分析了相关的测地线，并表明它们作为极值 Ryu-Takayanagi（RT）面，经历光滑的类时到类光转变。值得注意的是，我们证明这一连续轨迹暗示了一种独特的张量网络架构，其中键计数贡献在向深红外演化的离散类时到类光转变处自然截断。在所得架构中，沿视界的类光射线由零成本链接表示，因为相关切割不切断任何张量腿。这一网络结构成功复现了非幺正临界纠缠熵的对数标度，为 de Sitter RT 公式提供了键计数图像。我们的结果在涌现时空和离散全息纠缠两个层面提供了长期寻求的 dS/(c)MERA 对应。
classification.one_liner: 为非厄米临界费米子链构造非幺正 cMERA，从边界纠缠涌现 dS 时空并给出 dS/(c)MERA 对应的键计数 RT 图像。

2607.19492v2.title: Schr\"odinger perturbation theory for black hole quasinormal modes
2607.19492v2.abstract: Deviations from vacuum general relativity (such as modified theories or the presence of an environment) produce small shifts in black hole quasinormal mode (QNM) spectra. These effects are becoming increasingly relevant for gravitational wave astronomy as observations of ringdown spectra become more precise. To leading order in deviations from vacuum general relativity, frequency shifts can be calculated using eigenvalue perturbation theory. However, for Kerr, there is no systematic framework to compute higher order corrections. The major obstacle is that QNMs do not form a complete basis due to the non-self-adjointness of the system. Nevertheless, it was recently shown that QNMs are orthogonal with respect to an appropriate bilinear form. In this work, we use the bilinear form to systematically lift Schr\"odinger perturbation theory to the black hole setting. We obtain a formula for quasinormal frequency shifts to any order, in terms of lower order mode shifts. We also provide a spectral decomposition of the first-order mode shift, which involves projections onto unperturbed QNMs along with continuous-spectrum contributions---making incompleteness explicit. We illustrate the framework on slowly-spinning Kerr and P\"oschl-Teller examples, where we find that the QNM sum itself diverges.

classification.title_zh: 黑洞准正规模的薛定谔微扰理论
classification.abstract_zh: 对真空广义相对论的偏离（例如修改引力理论或存在环境）会使黑洞准正规模（QNM）谱产生微小移动。随着环降谱观测越来越精确，这些效应在引力波天文学中日益重要。在偏离真空广义相对论的领头阶，频率移动可用本征值微扰论计算。然而对于克尔黑洞，尚无系统框架计算高阶修正。主要障碍是系统非自伴，导致 QNM 不构成完备基。尽管如此，最近表明 QNM 关于适当的双线性形式正交。在本工作中，我们利用该双线性形式，将薛定谔微扰论系统地提升到黑洞情形。我们得到任意阶准正频率移动的公式，其用低阶模移动表示。我们还给出了一阶模移动的谱分解，其中包含对未微扰 QNM 的投影以及连续谱贡献——使不完备性显式化。我们在慢转克尔和 Pöschl-Teller 例子中展示了该框架，发现 QNM 求和本身发散。
classification.one_liner: 利用 QNM 的双线性正交性，将薛定谔微扰论推广到黑洞，给出任意阶准正频率移动公式，并表明一阶模移动的谱分解需要连续谱贡献且 QNM 求和可能发散。

2609.38217v1.title: Traversable Wormholes Supported by Conformally Coupled Scalar Fields in $D \geq 4$: Geometry, Geodesics, and Quasinormal Modes
2609.38217v1.abstract: In this work, we analyze a two-parameter $(\mu, b)$ asymmetric family of traversable wormhole solutions generated by a massless conformally coupled scalar field. We show that, for a suitable range of parameters, the spacetime is everywhere regular and has two asymptotically flat regions. We then define the wormhole throat and verify the flare-out condition, which leads to violations of the classical energy conditions in GR, thereby requiring exotic matter to hold the throat open. We further analyze the motion of photons governed by null geodesics through an effective potential. The resulting trajectories are computed numerically and visualized using embedding diagrams. Following this route, we investigate scalar perturbations governed by the massless Klein-Gordon equation and find the QNM spectrum semianalytically and numerically. Interestingly enough, we show that such perturbations are governed by only one parameter $\mu$. Therefore, in $D = 4$, we find an isospectrality between the wormhole and the BBMB/Extremal Reissner-Nordstr\"om black hole. In the spirit of the seminal work of Morris and Thorne, we derive the conditions for traversability and compute the proper time for a traveler to traverse the wormhole. Finally, we discuss possible extensions and future directions for our work.

classification.title_zh: D≥4 中由共形耦合标量场支撑的可穿越虫洞：几何、测地线与准正规模
classification.abstract_zh: 本文分析由无质量共形耦合标量场生成的一类双参数 (μ,b) 非对称可穿越虫洞解。我们表明在适当参数范围内，该时空处处正则并具有两个渐近平直区域。随后定义虫洞喉部并验证 flare-out 条件，这导致广义相对论中经典能量条件被违反，因此需要奇异物质来维持喉部张开。我们通过有效势分析由零测地线支配的光子运动，数值计算轨迹并用嵌入图可视化。沿此路线，研究由无质量 Klein-Gordon 方程支配的标量扰动，并半解析和数值地求出 QNM 谱。有趣的是，这些扰动仅由一个参数 μ 支配，因此在 D=4 中发现虫洞与 BBMB/极端 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞之间的等谱性。本着 Morris 和 Thorne 开创性工作的精神，我们推导可穿越性条件并计算旅行者穿越虫洞的固有时。最后讨论可能的扩展和未来方向。
classification.one_liner: 分析D≥4中双参数共形耦合标量场可穿越虫洞的几何、光子测地线、标量准正规模、等谱性与可穿越条件。

2609.38303v1.title: A Strong Cosmologically Coupled Mass Growth Solution in Linearized General Relativity
2609.38303v1.abstract: DESI Data Release 2 has heightened interest in cosmologically coupled black holes (CCBHs) as an explanation for accelerating late-time expansion, but known models for CCBHs grow too slowly to drive it. We construct at linear order a solution to General Relativity whose Hernandez-Misner-Sharp mass passively grows $\propto a^\kappa$ as the universe expands. The constant $\kappa$ enters all eigenvalues of the Weyl and stress-tensor operators, so growth is unambiguously physical in both free-field and material sectors. The solution is causal over spacetime relevant for stellar collapse compact objects. A cloud of energized vacuum emerges at $\kappa = 3$, complementing the $a^3$ scaling predicted elsewhere for the masses of energized vacuum black holes. This first step toward $\kappa \sim 3$ CCBH exact solutions enables observational tests with pulsar binaries.

classification.title_zh: 线性化广义相对论中一个强宇宙学耦合质量增长解
classification.abstract_zh: DESI Data Release 2 提高了对宇宙学耦合黑洞（CCBHs）作为加速晚期膨胀解释的兴趣，但已知的 CCBH 模型增长太慢，无法驱动该膨胀。我们在线性阶构造了一个广义相对论解，其 Hernandez-Misner-Sharp 质量随宇宙膨胀被动增长 ∝ a^κ。常数 κ 进入 Weyl 算符和应力-张量算符的所有本征值，因此这种增长在自由场和物质扇区中都是明确物理的。该解在恒星坍缩致密天体相关时空范围内是因果的。在 κ = 3 时出现一团被激发的真空云，补充了在其他地方为被激发真空黑洞质量预测的 a^3 标度。这是迈向 κ ∼ 3 的 CCBH 精确解的第一步，使得能够用脉冲星双星进行观测检验。
classification.one_liner: 在线性化广义相对论中构造了一个 Hernandez-Misner-Sharp 质量随尺度因子 ∝ a^κ 增长的宇宙学耦合黑洞解，为 κ∼3 情形和脉冲星双星观测检验铺路。

2609.38331v1.title: Towards solving General Relativity with Physics-Informed Neural Networks
2609.38331v1.abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) are a machine-learning framework for approximating solutions to systems of partial differential equations by constraining neural networks to satisfy the underlying physical laws. The resulting continuous representation does not require a predefined computational mesh and can be evaluated at arbitrary points within the training domain. In this work, we investigate the application of PINNs to Einstein's equations of General Relativity. We discuss the mathematical formulation, network architectures, loss functions, and training strategies used to obtain accurate spacetime solutions, and demonstrate the approach through a series of standard benchmarks from Numerical Relativity. We then extend the method to a more astrophysical setting by considering the dynamical evolution of an isolated solitonic boson star. Our simulations show that a PINN operating directly in three-dimensional Cartesian coordinates can reproduce the equilibrium structure of a highly compact boson star and recover its characteristic radial oscillation frequencies. These results establish PINNs as a viable complementary framework for solving coupled matter-Einstein equations and exploring alternative formulations in numerical relativity.

classification.title_zh: 迈向利用物理信息神经网络求解广义相对论
classification.abstract_zh: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）是一种机器学习框架，通过约束神经网络满足底层物理定律来近似偏微分方程组的解。由此得到的连续表示不需要预定义的计算网格，并可在训练域内任意点求值。在本工作中，我们研究将 PINNs 应用于广义相对论的 Einstein 方程。我们讨论用于获得精确时空解的数学表述、网络架构、损失函数和训练策略，并通过数值相对论中的一系列标准基准展示该方法。随后，我们将该方法扩展到更具天体物理背景的情形，考虑一个孤立孤子玻色星的动力学演化。我们的模拟表明，直接在三维笛卡尔坐标中运行的 PINN 可以重现高度致密玻色星的平衡结构，并恢复其标志性的径向振荡频率。这些结果确立了 PINNs 作为求解耦合物质-Einstein 方程以及探索数值相对论中替代表述的可行补充框架。
classification.one_liner: 将物理信息神经网络用于求解 Einstein 方程，并在数值相对论基准与孤子玻色星动力学中验证其可行性。

2609.39087v1.title: Primordial Tensor Signatures and Gravitational Wave Constraints in Lorentz Violating Inflation with Non-Canonical Kinetics
2609.39087v1.abstract: We investigate primordial tensor perturbations in a Lorentz violating inflationary framework with non-canonical scalar field dynamics. Using an Einstein-\AE{}ther type with a higher order kinetic term $K_3X^2$, we derive the tensor propagation speed and its dependence on an effective Lorentz violating coupling. We consider an analytically tractable potential free background and study two representative couplings, $q_k=\lambda_T\phi_k^2$ and $q_k=\lambda_T\phi_k^4$. The resulting tensor spectral index $n_T$ and its running $\alpha_T$ satisfy distinct consistency relations, providing potential signatures of Lorentz violation in the primordial gravitational wave spectrum. We derive corresponding constraints from the tensor tilt and running and compare them with the stringent late-time bound on the gravitational wave speed from GW170817/GRB170817A. We emphasize that translating this bound into primordial constraint requires an assumption about the evolution of tensor sector coupling between inflation and the late Universe. Our results demonstrate that primordial tensor observables can provide a complementary probe of Lorentz violation and its interplay with non-canonical inflationary dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 洛伦兹破坏暴胀中非正则动能的原初张量特征与引力波约束
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究洛伦兹破坏暴胀框架中带非正则标量场动力学的原初张量扰动。采用含高阶动能项 K3X^2 的爱因斯坦-以太型理论，导出张量传播速度及其对有效洛伦兹破坏耦合的依赖。我们考虑一个可解析处理的无势背景，并研究两种代表性耦合 q_k=λ_T φ_k^2 和 q_k=λ_T φ_k^4。所得张量谱指数 n_T 及其跑动 α_T 满足不同的一致性关系，为原初引力波谱中的洛伦兹破坏提供潜在特征。我们导出张量倾斜和跑动对应的约束，并将其与 GW170817/GRB170817A 给出的晚期引力波速度严格限制比较。我们强调，将该限制转化为原初约束需要对张量扇区耦合从暴胀到晚期宇宙的演化作出假设。结果表明，原初张量观测量可为洛伦兹破坏及其与非正则暴胀动力学的相互作用提供互补探针。
classification.one_liner: 在含非正则动能和爱因斯坦-以太型洛伦兹破坏的暴胀模型中，导出张量传播速度、谱指数与跑动的一致性关系，并讨论原初引力波约束及 GW170817 限制。
